title: Chapter 110 — Service, Parts, and The Repair Operation
intro: Service models, the repair flow, parts, and the service-sales alliance.

sections.title: Service Supports Sales
sections.content:
The service department is not a separate business. It is a sales ally. Customers who receive good service become repeat buyers. Service calls are also sales opportunities — a technician diagnosing an aging appliance can mention that the salesperson would be happy to discuss replacement options.

Build a relationship with your service team. Understand the repair flow. Know when a repair makes sense and when replacement is the better recommendation.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating service awareness, ask:

Does the salesperson have a working relationship with the service department?
Do they understand when to recommend repair vs. replacement?
Are they leveraging service interactions as relationship-building opportunities?
